## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature and SuttaCentral)

The *Koṇāgamanabuddhavaṁsa* (Bv 25) is a poetic biographical chapter within the *Buddhavaṁsa*, cataloged under the late canonical collections of the Sutta Piṭaka [SuttaCentral]. It chronicles the lineage and life story of the past Buddha Koṇāgamana [SuttaCentral]. SuttaCentral records two modern translations of the text in two languages [SuttaCentral].
While SuttaCentral does not catalog curated cross-canonical parallels, computational text-reuse analysis via DharmaNexus demonstrates significant formulaic continuity within the Pali tradition and across translations [DharmaNexus]. Internally, the text shares 413 matching passages with 30 other Pali works [DharmaNexus]. By far its most extensive textual correspondence is with its commentary, the *Buddhavaṃsa-aṭṭhakathā* (over 13,000 shared characters across 143 matches) [DharmaNexus]. It also exhibits high verse-level structural reuse with other biographical accounts in the *Buddhavaṁsa*, most notably the chapters on preceding and succeeding Buddhas such as *Kakusandhabuddhavaṁsa* (Bv 24), *Vessabhūbuddhavaṁsa* (Bv 23), *Sikhībuddhavaṁsa* (Bv 22), and *Kassapabuddhavaṁsa* (Bv 26) [DharmaNexus]. Outside the Pali corpus, DharmaNexus automatically aligns segments of the text with Tibetan translations, including the Tibetan *Jātakanidāna* (D0032) and the *Bhadrakalpikasūtra* (*Ārya-bhadrakalpikā-nāma-mahāyāna-sūtra*, D0094) [DharmaNexus].
*No discussion of this text was found in the reference-literature corpus; the overview relies on SuttaCentral and DharmaNexus data.*
